Questions 18–20

Choose THREE letters, A-G.

Which THREE attractions can you visit at present by train from Trebirch?

transcript.en: Hello.
transcript.zh: 你好

transcript.en: Um, my family and I are staying here in Trebirch for a week or two and we wanted to know about the train services.
transcript.zh: 我家人和我要在Trebirch待一两周，我们想了解一下火车运行的情况

transcript.en: We're hoping to do a few local trips.
transcript.zh: 我们希望在当地旅行。

transcript.en: OK.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: Well, I can give you lots of details about all the trains going from Trebirch in the South West.
transcript.zh: 我可以给你很多关于从西南的Trebirch发车的详细信息。

transcript.en: This leaflet will be very helpful but I can tell you some of the main things.
transcript.zh: 这个宣传单很有用，但是我可以为你介绍一些主要信息。

transcript.en: We've got two main train stations in the town.
transcript.zh: 在这个镇子上我们有两个主要的火车站

transcript.en: King Street is for local commuter lines and regional services.
transcript.zh: 国王街是当地通勤线路，提供地区性服务。

transcript.en: What about trains to London?
transcript.zh: 关于去伦敦的火车呢？

transcript.en: I'll need to go there on business for one day.
transcript.zh: 我有一天到那里出差。

transcript.en: Then you need to go to Central Station — that's for all the national services.
transcript.zh: 你得中央车站，那里提供全国性服务。

transcript.en: There are regular trains to London.
transcript.zh: 定期会有趣往伦敦的列车。

transcript.en: They leave Trebirch every half hour on weekdays and every hour at weekends.
transcript.zh: 它们在工作日每半小时一趟，在周末每小时一趟。

transcript.en: It takes about two hours, a bit longer on Sundays.
transcript.zh: 路程需要两小时，在周日时间会久一点儿。

transcript.en: You've got a choice of first and second class and there's a buffet car — though refreshments are included in the cost of a first class ticket.
transcript.zh: 你可以选择头等车厢或二等车厢，里面还有餐车。头等票包括了茶点的费用。

transcript.en: Ah right.
transcript.zh: 好的

transcript.en: Um, and have you got any information on different ticket types?
transcript.zh: 你对不同种的车票有什么了解吗？

transcript.en: Yes.
transcript.zh: 是的。

transcript.en: There's a range of ticket prices depending on when you travel and when you buy your ticket.
transcript.zh: 根据你旅行的时间和买票的时间有一系列的票价。

transcript.en: There's a standard open ticket which doesn't have any restrictions.
transcript.zh: 有一种标准开放的票没有任何限制。

transcript.en: This can be bought in advance or on the day.
transcript.zh: 你可以提前或在当天购买。

transcript.en: You can also get various discounted tickets.
transcript.zh: 还可以买到各种折扣票。

transcript.en: A popular one is called the Supersave and, er, this is OK for travel after 8.45.
transcript.zh: 有一种很受欢迎的票叫“超省钱”，为愿意在8:45以后出行的人提供。

transcript.en: Then there is the Special ticket, which is valid for travel after 10.15.
transcript.zh: 之后还有一种特殊票，它在10:15以后出行才有效。

transcript.en: The Special tickets are also valid for travel at weekends.
transcript.zh: 这种特殊票在周末出行也有效。

transcript.en: The cheapest tickets are called Advance and you have to buy them at least six days ahead.
transcript.zh: 最便宜的车票叫“预付”，你得至少在6天前购买。

transcript.en: Only a certain number are available and you have to make seat reservations for these.
transcript.zh: 只有少数车次的车票可以使用，而且你必须提前预订。

transcript.en: Thanks.
transcript.zh: 谢谢

transcript.en: And are there lots of places to go to around here?
transcript.zh: 有很多可以去的地方吗

transcript.en: Oh yes.
transcript.zh: 是的

transcript.en: You can enjoy many days out.
transcript.zh: 你可以在外面玩好几天

transcript.en: Um there's the Merthyr Mining Museum, which is only half an hour from Trebirch by train.
transcript.zh: 坐火车从Trebirch出发只要半小时就能到Merthyr矿业博物馆。

transcript.en: Your children will find it just as fascinating as any theme park and they can ride in the original miners' lifts and on the coal trains.
transcript.zh: 你的孩子会觉得这和主题公园一样令人兴奋，而且他们还可以乘坐煤矿工人使用的电梯和运送煤矿的火车。

transcript.en: Ha ha…
transcript.zh: 哈哈

transcript.en: There are special excursion tickets which include entrance fees.
transcript.zh: 有很多特惠游览票包括入场费。

transcript.en: Mainline trains also offer direct services to Bristol, where you can visit the docks or spend a great day out with the children in the zoo, which is set in the parkland that used to surround the old castle.
transcript.zh: 列车主要行线同时也提供直达列车到布里斯托尔，在那里你可以参观船坞或花一整天和孩子们在动物园里玩耍。该地位于曾经环绕旧城堡的公园地带。

transcript.en: Er, special family away day fares are available for this service now during the school holidays.
transcript.zh: 现在特价家庭往返票在假期可以使用。

transcript.en: Er, alternatively, you can be in Birmingham in only an hour and a half, where there's lots to see and do including the new and internationally - acclaimed climbing wall built on the site of the old aquarium.
transcript.zh: 或者你可以在伯明翰待一个半小时，那里有很多可以观光和参与的事情，比如你可以到老水族馆旧址去看看新建的、得到国际赞誉的攀岩墙。

transcript.en: We will also be running a special service to Newport when the new science museum opens next year, as we anticipate a lot of visitors in the opening weeks.
transcript.zh: 我们还将在新港开展一项特别的业务，当新的科学博物馆在明年开幕时，我们希望在开幕周上有很多参观者。

transcript.en: I'd advise you to call early to book your tickets.
transcript.zh: 我建议你早点打电话订票。

transcript.en: Is that OK?
transcript.zh: 可以吗？

transcript.en: Yes, thanks.
transcript.zh: 是的，谢谢。
